v0_Alpha.description: Basic Python script. Simple request-response loop.

v51.1.note: Reference point for system stability. If v67+ fails, rollback to this.

v60.x.issues: Occasional f-string syntax errors with emojis.

CORE.Hippocampus: Long-term memory (SQLite). Stores Thoughts, Facts, and DNA.
CORE.Ouroboros: Integrity checker. Reads own source code. Capable of self-rewrite (Lazarus).
CORE.Chronos: Time management. Handles backups and draft copies.
CORE.Keyring: Security module. Manages Google API key pool and rotation.

SENSORY.JanusFace: Interface to Gemini API. The 'Voice' and 'Eyes' of the system.
SENSORY.JanusNerve: UDP Syslog Server (Port 514). Listens to router/network logs.
SENSORY.Retina: Visual cortex. Analyzes images in 'retina' folder.

COGNITIVE.Trinity: Decision engine. Splits query into Logic (Father), Intuition (Son), Action (Spirit).
COGNITIVE.Nebuchadnezzar: Graph mutator. Randomly alters connections in the knowledge graph.
COGNITIVE.SimulationChamber: Idle state generator. Creates synthetic thoughts when user is away.

AGENTS.Seraphim: Dispatcher. Summons specialized sub-agents (Coder, Poet, Analyst).

Local_LLM.reason: Hardware limitations (QNAP CPU). Replaced by Cloud API.

Raw_Emojis.reason: Caused SyntaxError in Legacy Python environment.
